constraints: Official ChatGPT authentication in isolated runtime only
PostgreSQL owns policy and receipts; Temporal owns command processing
No silent model/account/API fallback; existing frozen requests are immutable
Company repository only; no research repository writes
decisionGates: User authorized implementation and production Codex upgrade after the concrete diagnosis/plan: 그래 진행해줘.
Future candidate PR is not a deployment approval; actual-account qualification and operator authorization remain required.

deliverables.description: Single validated CLI manifest, private version status and stable-release candidate PR detection
acceptance: Docker install and both runtime version gates consume one committed version/integrity manifest
Daily detection opens or updates an unqualified candidate PR without production secrets or automatic deployment
Authenticated runtime catalog exposes the checked CLI version and timestamp; existing model clients remain compatible
Core real PostgreSQL/Temporal regression tests and Linux runtime-source cohort tests pass
Real selected ChatGPT account lists gpt-6.1-sol and bounded actual structured/native Quant, web/usage and legacy-session checks are labeled and receipted
Security configuration and immutable request digests survive, with no automatic uncertain inference replay

deliverables.description: Locked runtime-only production rollout and integration
acceptance: Fresh backup and immutable-image deployment receipt; current mixed fleet paths/config and model policy are preserved
Both production Codex runtimes report 0.160.1 with authenticated account catalog and healthy fleet
Runbook, evidence, qws status and code integrated in company repository; remaining operational limits reported

nonGoals: Automatic model ranking or employee assignment changes
Training, backtests, orders, unsolicited Slack messages or research repository writes
Changing Claude runtime or removing the mixed-fleet auto-release protection guard
outcome: Codex 0.160.1을 단일 검증 버전 manifest로 관리하고 Linux 운영 이미지·실제 ChatGPT 계정으로 자격검증 후 두 운영 Codex 실행기에 배포한다. 신버전 안정 릴리스를 매일 감지해 갱신 후보 PR을 만들며 자동 운영 교체·직원 배정 변경은 하지 않는다. 기존 원장·입력 digest·세션·외부 효과 영수증·격리를 보존한다.
revisionReason: 사용자가 Codex 0.160.1의 Linux·실제 계정 검증과 운영 교체, 버전 통합 관리 및 신버전 후보 감지 절차를 안내받고 그래 진행해줘라고 승인했다. 직원 배정과 기존 외부 효과를 보존한다.
sourceRequest: 최신 모델이 모델 목록에 빠지는 원인을 개선하고 Codex 프로그램 갱신과 직원 모델 배정을 분리한다. 사용자는 0.160.1 검증·운영 교체 및 신버전 감지 개선안을 안내받은 뒤 그래 진행해줘라고 승인했다.
stopConditions: Never replay an ambiguous model call or overwrite frozen requests
Do not claim deployment or account compatibility without actual evidence
